listing.name: WCW Mayhem — WCW-Mayhem-RECOMP (dotGrx)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Upstream native x64 wrestling project with widescreen/controller/mod features;21:9/fit-to-window untested. Full roster/matches/completion not Portcove-verified. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL Europe WCWMayhem SLES02193 CUE/BIN, track1 MD5 f05d7e5edad41f89e3c679dad83ea5f2. Keep file/hash scope as declared track1; no other disc revisions inferred.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the project’s ZIP and WCWMayhemLauncher.exe, then select your own PAL CUE/BIN through GAMEFILES. Building from source uses the pinned portable PSX toolchain and a .NET 10 launcher. Portcove has not inspected the actual archive.

warnings: Upstream native x64 wrestling project with widescreen/controller/mod features;21:9/fit-to-window untested. Full roster/matches/completion not Portcove-verified.
